Maharashtr men vidhan parishad ki panch siton ke chunav natijon ne sattarurh mahayuti aur vipakshi MVA ke bich siyasi samikarnon ko lekar naee charcha chher di hai. tin siten jitkar MVA ne barhat banaee, jabki nagpur men kangres ki jit ne khas dhyan khincha. is vidiyo men chunav natijon aur alag-alag kshetron men partiyon ke pradarshan ka vishleshan kiya gaya hai.
Thank you for watching our video!
